test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In February 2022, Cabinet approved implementation of Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission. Which ministry of central government launched the Ayushman Bharat Yojana across the country?

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** launched the** Ayushman Bharat Yojana** across the country.
 
• Ayushman Bharat Yojana, also known as Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, is a health insurance scheme launched by the Government of India in September 2018. 
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial protection to around 10 crore families, i.e. approximately *50 crore individuals*, who are vulnerable due to their socio-economic status.
 
• The scheme provides a health cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year, for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Education **is responsible for the** **development and implementation of education policies in India.
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development **is responsible for the welfare and development of women and children in the country.
 
• **Ministry of Ayush** is responsible for the development and promotion of traditional systems of medicine and healthcare in India.
